name: Reganto Enterprises Limited
about: Reganto Enterprises Limited manufactures, deals in, and sells electronic security and surveillance related electronic equipment in India. It offers CCTV cameras and digital video recorders. The company also provides IT solutions, systems integration, technology-related services, and EPC services. The company was formerly known as Vintron Informatics Limited and change its name to Reganto Enterprises Limited in December 2025. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.
